title: 原価管理
subtitle: Cost Accounting and Cost Management
keywords: Job-order costing 2.Manufacturing overhead 3.Standard costing 4.Cost differences analysis 5.ABC costing
educationalGoal: This course corresponds to the “Financial Ability” learning and educational goal of the Department of Management Systems. The goal is for students to understand the process of calculating product costs and sales costs in the manufacturing industry in relation to industrial bookkeeping, and to learn cost management concepts and accounting methods while learning how to analyze cost differences that occur in job-order costing and standard costing.
advice: Students will first learn the basics of cost accounting and manufacturing cost statements. They will then learn job-order costing and cost differences analysis, standard costing and cost differences analysis, and ABC (activity-based costing). Finally, students will learn strategic cost management. Through these, students should understand the relationship between the cost determination process and cost management. Since step-by-step learning takes place, students are expected to make a serious effort to keep up.
requiredKnowledge: As the contents learned in finance-related classes will be effectively utilized, students should review the contents learned in these previous courses before attending the class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the cost elements that compose product cost.
Be able to understand the relationship between cost records and financial statements.
Be able to understand cost summary procedures and account entry in job-order costing.
Understand the allocation procedure for manufacturing overhead and the analysis of allocation differences.
Be able to understand cost summary procedures and cost differences analysis in standard costing.
Be able to understand ABC (activity-based costing.)

achievementLevels.ideal: ・Be able to explain the importance of cost management by considering cost components from a cost management perspective. ・Be able to understand the entire process of industrial bookkeeping and be able to understand the relationship with financial statements. ・Be able to understand the cost summary procedure for job-order costing and be able to handle manufacturing overhead allocation differences and scrap costs. ・Be able to understand the cost summary procedures for standard costing and process cost differences analysis. ・Be able to understand ABC and be able to explain it with concrete examples.
achievementLevels.standard: ・Be able to list cost elements and give a simple explanation of each. ・Be able to understand the entire process of industrial bookkeeping. ・Be able to understand the cost summary procedure for job-order costing. ・Be able to understand the cost summary procedure for standard costing. ・Be able to understand that cost differences analysis is important in cost management. ・Be able to understand ABC (activity-based costing.)
